system.description:
Cunei Myrgha Inheritance: a business. Uncommon, Air. No item slots.

Prerequisites: Society:Cultural Lore[1], Social Graces: Speaker[1], Proficiency[3]

You are a dedicated civil servant, and a diplomat.

Influential (Ceremony): Every Long Rest that you take in your home city, you must spend at least one Long Rest action working for the Ministry. When you do, choose one effect:
Take Pay: Gain 50gp
Learn Cultures: Roll a Society:Cultural Lore Check, but learn something about any other culture rather than your own. You can learn secret or hidden facts about other cultures through this roll.

Rulebook p.45.
